body:
Hydrocodone +  Weed= Synergy
I had a few Lortab (7.5mg Hydrocodone/500mg APAP) pills so I took two, which added up to 15 mg Hydrocodone.  I enjoyed the relaxation brought on by the narcotic and as that faded I went about the rest of my day.  That night (about 6-8 hours after taking the hydro)I got up with some friends to smoke some bud like we do pretty much every night, forgetting about the hydrocodone I had taken earlier that day. I took about 3 hits and I was blazed out of my gourd, I'm a pretty heavy smoker so it usually takes much longer than that for me to get blitzed, but the lingering effests of the hydrocodone intensified the feeling quite a bit.  I was higher than I had been in a long tinme, just after one bowl, it was great.  I felt an intense stone, not so much the feeling of being on a pain killer, but like I'd just smoked bud that was way better than what I was smoking (I wasn't smkoking schwag, it was some nice nug, but still, it can always be better :)  )I'd done this before intentionally about a year before during a long car ride (I was not driving) and had an equally spectacular experience.
